invariants.rationale: Average record size (result) is a non-negative long, as it is ultimately derived from file size estimates or computed averages of written data.
Either default estimate is returned, or result comes from a recent commit and is reasonable with respect to known thresholds.
If no commit exists, the method always returns the copy-on-write record size estimate.
The result, representing an average record size, cannot logically exceed the configured small file size limit.
If the result is less than or equal to the default estimate, then either there was data to use or we fell back to the estimate.
